contentPattern.structure: tab labels + per-tab rich text content (headings, paragraphs, image, links)

suitableFor: detail-page tab sets holding freeform rich text (overview / itinerary / details)
small tabbed content switchers where each panel is prose + optional image
any tabs interface whose panels are authored rich-text rather than repeated card grids
notSuitableFor: category tabs that filter/switch a grid of image cards (use tabs-filter)
